name: CIG Valley Line Expansion

values.EndLocation: Nixon Power Plant, El Paso County

researcher_notes: Colorado Interstate Gas (CIG) FERC docket CP01-45 Valley Line Expansion. Federal Register notice of 12 Feb 2001 (FR Doc 01-3435): about 35.1 mi of 24 in loop from the Ault Meter Station to the proposed Fort Lupton Compressor Station, both in Weld County, plus about 84 mi of 20 in line roughly parallel to the existing Valley Line from Watkins Compressor Station in southern Adams County to the Nixon Power Plant in El Paso County south of Colorado Springs; 119 mi total, plus 4,450 hp at Fort Lupton. The notice gives 278.8 MMcf/d added Cheyenne Hub to Watkins and 344.4 MMcf/d on the paralleled Valley Line portion. EIA August 2026 release, sheet 'Historical Projects (1996-2024)', Excel row 263: Colorado Interstate Gas Co, Expansion, Completed, in service 2002-12-01, 119 mi, 20 and 24 in, 282 MMcf/d added, cost 72.14 million (staged as 72140000 USD, source says millions), FERC CP01-45. Status operating rests on the EIA Completed entry (one origin). Not a duplicate: existing P0168 is the whole CIG system row with no expansion rows; the Front Range Expansion (CP01-1, 53.2 mi 24 in, EIA row 197) and PSCo Front Range Pipeline (CP98-49) are separate projects, the notice itself separates CP01-1 compression from this one. The queue note said Cheyenne Hub to Denver; the FR notice shows the line ends near Colorado Springs. ProposalYear not staged because no source states it. Length 119 mi is above the 25 km rule. Owner style per entity_style: Colorado Interstate Gas Company LLC; parent Kinder Morgan not staged (not stated in the sources). Route: no route researched; official GIS not checked, so staged as no route. Tier medium: length, diameter and endpoints are from the notice; status, capacity, cost and start year are EIA only.
